summary: Console > Dedicated Pool Rollouts: stage status flickers/inconsistent between list + detail view (stuck at "Evaluating" while gates show "Pass")
description:
Issue Summary
- The Console rollout page is showing inconsistent stage status for Dedicated staged rollouts.
- Symptoms:
  1) Rollouts list page shows Stage 1 as "Evaluating" (spinner) while the rollout detail page shows the same stage as "Ready for approval".
  2) Stage header sometimes displays "Paused" while all gates in that stage are green ("Pass") and the evaluator timeline shows the last evaluation succeeded.
  3) Refreshing the page (or switching between tabs) causes the stage status badge to flicker between "Evaluating" and "Ready".

Impact
- Oncall operators are unsure whether a rollout is blocked or safe to approve.
- Creates risk of approving at the wrong time and makes dogfood rollouts difficult to operate.

Scope
- Observed on at least 2 rollouts in staging; one report from prod during internal dry-run.
- Appears limited to Dedicated staged rollouts (not legacy all-at-once pool updates).

Steps to Reproduce (staging)
1) In staging console, navigate to Dedicated Pools > (any dogfood pool) > Rollouts.
2) Open rollout "ded-rollout-dogfood-0129".
3) Wait for evaluator to complete a tick (approx. 30–60s).
4) Observe Stage 1 tile state on the list page vs the detail page.
5) Trigger a manual approval for Stage 1 (if permissioned) and watch status updates over the next tick.

Expected
- Stage status is a single source of truth and consistent across list and detail.
- If gates are all Pass and approval is required, stage should be "Ready for approval".
- If metrics are missing or evaluator is degraded, stage should be "Hold" with clear reason.

Actual
- Stage status differs across UI surfaces and sometimes shows stale state after approval.

Attachments / Screenshots
- attachment: INT-1120_screenshot_1.png (list view shows Stage 1 = Evaluating)
- attachment: INT-1120_screenshot_2.png (detail view shows Stage 1 = Ready for approval)
- attachment: INT-1120_screenshot_3.png (stage header shows Paused while gates are Pass)

Notes
- Time window where this happens is most visible when approvals are submitted near an evaluator tick boundary.
- Might be related to websocket updates vs polling fallback (detail view seems to update sooner than list).

References
- Related GitHub work suspected: console rollout status aggregation endpoint + stage state machine changes.
- Slack thread: #eng-platform "rollouts get stuck between stages" (see thread_1733779100_902317)
comments: 2025-01-29 10:14 (Owen Phillips): First noticed during dogfood on staging. List view stuck on "Evaluating" for ~3 min even though detail showed "Ready for approval" and approve button was enabled. Added screenshots to attachments. This is confusing enough that I’d like to treat as P1 for operator usability.

2025-01-29 11:02 (Hannah Rivera): Acknowledged. Looking at console-backend aggregator response vs FE state mapping. Can you paste the rollout_id + pool_id + timestamps where it flickered? Also which browser/session (incognito vs normal) in case caching is involved.

2025-01-29 11:18 (Owen Phillips): rollout_id=rp_7f2f8b4d, pool_id=ded-pool-dogfood-03. Observed between 10:05–10:12 PT. Chrome 121 normal profile. Flicker stops after hard refresh, then comes back after next approval.

2025-01-29 12:40 (Felix Schneider): I pulled logs for rollout status endpoint in staging. Seeing two near-simultaneous updates: approval event writes plan_version N+1 while evaluator tick still publishing stage summary for version N. Aggregator is returning mixed fields (stage_state from version N, gates_summary from version N+1). That would explain “paused but gates pass” and list/detail mismatch (different query paths).

2025-01-29 13:15 (Hannah Rivera): This sounds like a versioning / race condition in the stage advancement state machine. I’m going to loop in backend to confirm whether the aggregator should enforce a single plan_version per response.

2025-01-30 09:07 (Hannah Rivera): Confirmed: console list uses /rollouts?pool_id=… which hits cached stage summaries; detail view calls /rollouts/{id}/status (no cache). Cache TTL is 60s which amplifies the mismatch when approvals land. Proposed fix: cache by (rollout_id, plan_version) and invalidate on approval/abort events; also ensure response is internally consistent (single version).

2025-01-31 16:22 (Hannah Rivera): Fix is in review; adds locking/idempotency to stage advancement and ensures aggregator snapshot is consistent. Will also add UI copy for "Hold (metrics stale)" so Paused isn’t overloaded. Tracking in related PRs.

2025-02-03 14:55 (Owen Phillips): Verified in staging after deploy: list + detail now consistent across multiple approve actions and evaluator ticks. No flicker observed over ~20 minutes. Closing ticket.
investigation_notes:
Findings
- Root cause appears to be inconsistent snapshotting across plan versions when approval arrives concurrently with evaluator tick.
- The console list endpoint path was serving cached rollout summaries that weren’t invalidated on approval events.
- Aggregator could return mixed data sourced from different plan_version / stage_version values, leading to contradictory UI state.

Signals
- Backend logs show approval event processed at T0 while evaluator tick for previous version completes at T0+~1s.
- UI mismatch strongly correlates with approvals submitted within ~5s of evaluator tick.

Mitigation / Workaround
- Hard refresh sometimes helps (forces detail path) but not reliable; operators were instructed to trust detail view + audit log until fix shipped.
resolution: Resolved by backend changes ensuring rollout status responses are consistent to a single plan_version and by invalidating cached rollout summaries on approval/abort/hold events. After rollout to staging, reproduced scenario no longer shows mismatch between list and detail pages.
